sources.title: Reflective listening as part of MI
sources.quote: More complex reflections can expand a client’s self-exploration.
sources.technique: Move beyond rephrasing by offering a tentative reflection of the feeling or underlying meaning you hear, then listen for the client’s response and adjust rather than treating your interpretation as fact.

sources.title: Advanced Empathy Skills
sources.quote: The issue cycle ... focuses on the emotional and meaning aspects of the client’s story.
sources.technique: When the client’s account is clear, deepen the response by reflecting the emotion or personal meaning in the story, rather than repeating its content.

sources.title: welf1003: Topic 9 The process of counselling
sources.quote: The basic listening sequence incorporates the microskills of ‘open and closed questions’, ‘client observation skills’, ‘encouraging, paraphrasing and summarising’, plus the microskill of ‘reflection of feeling’.
sources.technique: Vary the listening response to fit what needs exploring—use an encourager for a meaningful word, reflect feeling to explore emotion, and summarize to draw together themes—instead of defaulting to another paraphrase and question.
